No ground-truth theta available. Instead we use:
  a) Convergence diagnostics: R-hat, ESS, divergences
  b) Model comparison: WAIC, LOO-CV via ArviZ
  c) External validity: Kendall-tau with Chatbot Arena Elo (if available)
  d) Parameter interpretation: c_n per model, d_j per judge
  e) Cross-method comparison: rank correlation between methods

Dependencies: numpy, scipy, arviz, matplotlib, json
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path

import arviz as az
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import kendalltau, spearmanr


# Chatbot Arena ELO (snapshot: 2026-05-19, source: lmarena.ai)
ARENA_ELO = {
    "gpt-4o": 1300,
    "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022": 1298,
    "gpt-4o-mini": 1286,
    "llama-3.3-70b": 1275,

    "llama-3-70b-instruct": 1221,
    "gemma-2-9b": 1207,
    "gpt-4-0314": 1206,
    "claude-3-haiku-20240307": 1195,
    "gpt-4-0613": 1186,
    "llama-3-8b-instruct": 1166,
    "mixtral-8x22b-instruct-v0.1": 1162,
    "gpt-3.5-turbo-0125": 1125,
}

# Estimated ELO for models without official Arena ranking (NOT ground truth)
ESTIMATED_ELO = {"qwen3-8b": 1170}

# Name mapping: data model names → ARENA_ELO keys
ARENA_NAME_MAPPING = {
    "gemma-2-9b-it": "gemma-2-9b",
    "gpt-4o-2024-05-13": "gpt-4o",
    "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18": "gpt-4o-mini",
    "gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09": "gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09",

    "llama-3-70b": "llama-3-70b-instruct",
    "llama-3-8b": "llama-3-8b-instruct",
    "mixtral-8x22b": "mixtral-8x22b-instruct-v0.1",
}



def convergence_report(results: dict) -> dict:
    """Summarize convergence diagnostics across methods."""
    report = {}
    for name, res in results.items():
        diag = res.get("diagnostics", {})
        report[name] = {
            "r_hat": diag.get("r_hat", float("nan")),
            "ess": diag.get("ess", float("nan")),
            "divergences": diag.get("divergences", 0),
        }
